title: Bigelow's desert alien encounter: 'meet us in space'

tellings.quote: >> Well, Dr. told me that that he he started this aerospace company of his um uh because uh he'd had uh an alien experience of his own out in the desert and um that um uh they told him to meet them in space.

plain: The businessman Robert Bigelow is said to have started his space company because he had an encounter with aliens out in the desert, and they told him to meet them in space. Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in people's bodies, says an unnamed doctor told him this. If true, it would mean a private space company was born from a meeting with aliens.
